description: Defines the ProgrammerOperatorsPanel class for UI automation testing of programmer mode in a calculator app, including element references and shift/word size reset methods.

classes.name: ProgrammerOperatorsPanel
classes.description: UI automation class for programmer mode elements and actions in the calculator app.

methods.name: SetArithmeticShift
methods.description: Sets the shift mode to arithmetic shift by clicking shift buttons.

methods.name: SetLogicalShift
methods.description: Sets the shift mode to logical shift.

methods.name: SetRotateCircularShift
methods.description: Sets the shift mode to rotate circular.

methods.name: SetRotateThroughCarryCircularShift
methods.description: Sets the shift mode to rotate through carry.

methods.name: ResetWordSize
methods.description: Resets the word size to default by clicking appropriate buttons based on page source.
